# hpe_opsramp_template (Resource)

Manages an OpsRamp G2 monitoring template. G2 templates describe their monitors using `metric_groups`. This resource does not support generation-1 templates.




<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (String) A description of the template.
- `metric_groups` (Attributes List) The G2 metric groups that make up this template. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metric_groups))
- `name` (String) The template name.
- `template_type` (String) Template category.

### Optional

- `application_type` (String) Application type(s) associated with the template, required when `template_type` = `Application`. Sent to the API as a single-element `applicationType` array. Valid values are the `name` field returned by `GET /api/v2/monitoring/adapterTypes` (e.g. `APACHE_TOMCAT` for Apache Tomcat templates).
- `client` (String) The unique ID of the client (sub-tenant). If not provided, the template is managed at the provider tenant level.
- `eol_date` (String) The end-of-life date for the template, mandatory when status = `EOL`.
- `prerequisites` (String) Pre-requisite details needed before applying the template.
- `status` (String) The template activity status. Valid values: `ACTIVE`, `INACTIVE`, `EOL`. Defaults to `ACTIVE`.
- `template_family` (String) The template family grouping.

### Read-Only

- `assigned_to_resources` (Boolean) Whether the template is currently assigned to any resources.
- `collector_type` (String) The collector type. Valid values: `OpsRamp Agent`, `OpsRamp Gateway`, `Synthetics`.
- `created_date` (String) Timestamp when the template was created.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier (UUID) of the template.
- `mon_template_ver` (Number) The monitoring template version.
- `scope` (String) The template scope (e.g. `GLOBAL`, `PARTNER`, `CLIENT`).
- `sdk_tag` (String) SDK tag associated with exported template payloads.

<a id="nestedatt--metric_groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `metric_groups`

Required:

- `frequency` (Number) Polling frequency, in minutes.
- `name` (String) The metric group name.

Optional:

- `adapter_type` (String) The adapter type (e.g. `APPLICATION`).
- `additional_properties` (Attributes List) Extra SNMP OIDs collected alongside this metric group's metrics. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metric_groups--additional_properties))
- `application_type` (String) The application type for script-based (RSE) metric groups. Valid values are the `name` field returned by `GET /api/v2/monitoring/adapterTypes` (e.g. `RSE`).
- `component_properties` (Attributes) Controls how component instances discovered by this metric group are named. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metric_groups--component_properties))
- `configuration_parameters` (Attributes List) Configurable input parameters for this metric group. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metric_groups--configuration_parameters))
- `discovery_metric` (String) The metric used to auto-discover component instances for this metric group.
- `instance_filter` (Attributes) Scopes which discovered component instances this metric group applies to, for SNMP/JMX/VMware metric groups. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metric_groups--instance_filter))
- `is_multi_instance` (Boolean) Whether this metric group can report multiple component instances. When `true`, `component_properties`, `additional_properties`, and `instance_filter` are required.
- `metrics` (Attributes List) The metrics collected by this metric group. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metric_groups--metrics))
- `otel_metrics_config` (Attributes) OpenTelemetry-based metric collection configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metric_groups--otel_metrics_config))
- `script` (String) The script content executed to collect this metric group's data, for RSE metric groups.

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The metric group ID assigned by the API.
- `input_scope_component` (Boolean) Whether users can scope this metric group to specific components when applying the template.

<a id="nestedatt--metric_groups--additional_properties"></a>
### Nested Schema for `metric_groups.additional_properties`

Required:

- `name` (String) The property name (e.g. `ifAdminStatus`).

Optional:

- `default_value` (String) The default value for this property.
- `description` (String) A description of this property.
- `enumerated_map` (Attributes List) Maps raw collected values to display labels. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metric_groups--additional_properties--enumerated_map))
- `format_value` (String) How the collected value is formatted (e.g. `NONE`, `ENUMARATED_MAP`).
- `id` (String) The additional property's identifier, assigned by the API.
- `oid` (String) The SNMP OID collected for this property.
- `oid_type` (String) The OID type (e.g. `SCALAROID`, `TABULAROID`).
- `operand` (String) An optional operand paired with `operator`.
- `operator` (String) An optional comparison operator applied to the collected value (e.g. `NONE`, `ADD`, `MULTIPLY`, `DEVIDE`).
- `units` (String) The unit label displayed alongside the collected value.

<a id="nestedatt--metric_groups--additional_properties--enumerated_map"></a>
### Nested Schema for `metric_groups.additional_properties.enumerated_map`

Required:

- `key` (String) The raw collected value.
- `value` (String) The display label for `key`.



<a id="nestedatt--metric_groups--component_properties"></a>
### Nested Schema for `metric_groups.component_properties`

Optional:

- `format` (String) The format applied to the resolved component name (e.g. `NONE`, `COUNTER64`).
- `id` (String) The component property's identifier, assigned by the API.
- `lookup_oid` (String) The SNMP OID used to look up the component index, for SNMP-based metric groups.
- `mode` (String) How the component name is resolved (e.g. `VALUE`, `INDEX`, `INDEX_LOOKUP`, `INDEX_VALUE`).
- `name` (String) The property used to name discovered components (e.g. `Name`).
- `oid` (String) The SNMP OID used to resolve the component name, for SNMP-based metric groups.


<a id="nestedatt--metric_groups--configuration_parameters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `metric_groups.configuration_parameters`

Required:

- `name` (String) The parameter name, referenced in the script as `${name}`.

Optional:

- `collector_type` (String) The collector type this parameter applies to (e.g. `Application`).
- `configurable` (Boolean) Whether the parameter value can be overridden when applying the template.
- `default_value` (String) The default value for the parameter.
- `description` (String) A description of the parameter.
- `display_name` (String) The label shown in the UI when applying the template.
- `input_option_values` (String) JSON-encoded list of selectable values, required when `input_type` is `radio`.
- `input_type` (String) The input widget type (e.g. `text`, `radio`).
- `vistara_custom_param_id` (Number) References a well-known, cross-template catalog parameter (e.g. `738` for the standard "Application Type" prompt). Leave unset for custom parameters.

Read-Only:

- `id` (Number) The parameter ID assigned by the API once saved on the template.


<a id="nestedatt--metric_groups--instance_filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `metric_groups.instance_filter`

Optional:

- `discovery_filters` (Attributes List) Conditions used to automatically match component instances. Required when `instance_type` is `AUTOMATIC_INSTANCE`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metric_groups--instance_filter--discovery_filters))
- `instance_names` (List of String) The specific instance names this metric group applies to. Required when `instance_type` is `MANUAL_INSTANCE`.
- `instance_type` (String) Which discovered instances this metric group applies to.

<a id="nestedatt--metric_groups--instance_filter--discovery_filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `metric_groups.instance_filter.discovery_filters`

Required:

- `operator` (String) The comparison operator (e.g. `CONTAINS`, `NOT_REGEX_MATCHES`).
- `value` (String) The value compared against the discovered instance name.



<a id="nestedatt--metric_groups--metrics"></a>
### Nested Schema for `metric_groups.metrics`

Required:

- `name` (String) The monitor name shown for this linked metric in the template.
- `threshold_type` (String) Alerting condition type.

Optional:

- `alert_content` (String) The content/body for alerts related to this metric. Omit (do not set to "") to use the built-in default.
- `alert_on_missing_components` (Boolean) Whether to alert when components are missing.
- `alert_subject` (String) The subject line for alerts related to this metric. Omit (do not set to "") to use the built-in default.
- `availability` (Boolean) Whether this metric contributes to availability.
- `category` (String) The metric category (e.g. `METRIC`, `EVENT`). For metrics referencing a library metric, defaults to the value returned by the API.
- `description` (String) A description of this metric. For metrics referencing a library metric, defaults to the value returned by the API.
- `display_name` (String) The label shown in the UI for this metric. For metrics referencing a library metric, defaults to the value returned by the API.
- `expression` (String) A formula referencing `metric_values` names, for SNMP/JMX/VMware metric groups.
- `format_metric_value_details` (Attributes) Display/formatting configuration, for SNMP/JMX/VMware metric groups. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metric_groups--metrics--format_metric_value_details))
- `metric_category` (String) Reserved for future use; not currently populated by the API.
- `metric_values` (Attributes List) Inline OID/formula definitions feeding `expression`, for SNMP/JMX/VMware metric groups. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metric_groups--metrics--metric_values))
- `thresholds` (Attributes List) Threshold definitions for this metric. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metric_groups--metrics--thresholds))

<a id="nestedatt--metric_groups--metrics--format_metric_value_details"></a>
### Nested Schema for `metric_groups.metrics.format_metric_value_details`

Optional:

- `format_metric_value` (Attributes) Formatting/interpretation rules for the metric value. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metric_groups--metrics--format_metric_value_details--format_metric_value))
- `graph` (Boolean) Whether this metric is graphed.
- `units` (String) The unit label displayed alongside the metric value (e.g. `MBytes`).

<a id="nestedatt--metric_groups--metrics--format_metric_value_details--format_metric_value"></a>
### Nested Schema for `metric_groups.metrics.format_metric_value_details.format_metric_value`

Optional:

- `alerts` (Boolean) Whether alerts are enabled for this metric's formatted value.
- `enumerated_map` (Attributes List) Maps raw collected values to display labels (e.g. when `used_by` is `ENUMARATED_MAP`). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metric_groups--metrics--format_metric_value_details--format_metric_value--enumerated_map))
- `graph` (Boolean) Whether this formatted value is graphed.
- `used_by` (String) How the enumerated map, if any, is used to interpret the metric value.

<a id="nestedatt--metric_groups--metrics--format_metric_value_details--format_metric_value--enumerated_map"></a>
### Nested Schema for `metric_groups.metrics.format_metric_value_details.format_metric_value.enumerated_map`

Required:

- `key` (String) The raw collected value.
- `value` (String) The display label for `key`.




<a id="nestedatt--metric_groups--metrics--metric_values"></a>
### Nested Schema for `metric_groups.metrics.metric_values`

Required:

- `name` (String) The variable name, referenced by `expression` (e.g. `hrStorageUsed`).

Optional:

- `data_type` (String) The collected value's data type (e.g. `COUNTER64`).
- `formula` (String) An optional per-value transformation formula.
- `oid` (String) The SNMP OID collected for this variable.
- `oid_type` (String) The OID type (e.g. `SCALAROID`, `TABLEOID`).
- `poll_frequency` (String) The polling frequency for this metric value (e.g. `NORMAL`, `LESSFREQUENCY`).


<a id="nestedatt--metric_groups--metrics--thresholds"></a>
### Nested Schema for `metric_groups.metrics.thresholds`

Optional:

- `availability` (Boolean) Whether this metric contributes to availability.
- `comp_name` (String) Component name used when `level_type` is `TEMPLATE_COMPONENT` or `COMPONENT`.
- `critical_operator` (String) Comparison operator applied to the critical threshold (e.g. `GREATER_THAN_EQUAL`, `EQUALS_IGNORE_CASE`).
- `critical_repeat_count` (Number) Number of consecutive breaches before raising a critical alert.
- `critical_threshold` (String) The critical threshold value. The API expects threshold values as strings.
- `level_type` (String) The threshold level type.
- `raise_alert` (Boolean) Whether breaching this threshold raises an alert.
- `warning_operator` (String) Comparison operator applied to the warning threshold.
- `warning_repeat_count` (Number) Number of consecutive breaches before raising a warning alert.
- `warning_threshold` (String) The warning threshold value. The API expects threshold values as strings.



<a id="nestedatt--metric_groups--otel_metrics_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `metric_groups.otel_metrics_config`

Required:

- `receiver_config_yaml` (String) The OpenTelemetry receiver configuration, as YAML.

Optional:

- `alert_definitions_yaml` (String) Alert definitions for OpenTelemetry-collected metrics, as YAML.
- `config_type` (String) The OpenTelemetry configuration type (e.g., `nativeOtel` or `prometheus`).
- `external_exporter` (Boolean) Whether metrics are exported by an external OpenTelemetry exporter rather than collected directly.
- `external_exporter_cmd_line_config` (String) The command line configuration for the external OpenTelemetry exporter, if `external_exporter` is `true`.
- `external_exporter_name` (String) The name of the external OpenTelemetry exporter, if `external_exporter` is `true`.
